coverage_note: Echo-candidates file was not provided, so no echo list. The transcript is mostly English meta-talk, and Medi's Arabic is thin in many stretches. Not filed (S4 root-letter slips): يسبط/بيسبط at 56:40 and بيبسوت at 58:03 (letters swapped), and مقلوبة (Amal said مكلوبة). Not filed (self-fixes before Amal): 'بي صوت -> بصوت' at 00:46, 'واحد -> واحدة' at 10:09, 'حلوة -> حلو' at 20:09. 06:57 'ما خطت إشي': Amal's chat typed m5a66et (= ma 5a66et, correct past) but she heard مخطط; Amal's mishearing, not filed. 18:12 Amal 'Ana.' after 'أنا جربت' is not clearly a fix, not filed. 20:52 Amal's guesses at the dessert name (معمول / كعك) are not supplied words, not filed. 47:05 'نختار' vs Amal's chat 'ne5dar': probably engine for نحضر, not filed. 10:39 'نظارات' vs her chat 'kundara': probably engine. 58:12 'الزهر' is probably the engine for الصغار (her chat: el-z8aar). 27:21 'el-tenain' unclear. The 35:37 slip is unclear in the transcript: his attempt at طريق التاني was dropped by the engine, and only Amal's 'you said طريق التاني' shows it. 12:19 and 15:45 are two separate كان/كانت slips: Amal fixed it each time and about 3 minutes passed between them. All 'asked' rows are tier 0 didn't-knows.
